plans.note: Separate IBM (9.1) and Customer (9.2) caps — check for asymmetry in cap amount and in consequential-damages exclusions, plus carve-outs (indemnity, confidentiality, data breach). 5.4 and 14.14 may add further limits/short claim period.

8.1 is the IBM indemnity (test IP-claim scope and defense/settlement control); 8.2 plus the procedural list at sec-1 govern our reverse indemnity, which should stay narrow and subject to the liability cap.
14.16 Freedom of Action likely preserves both parties' freedom to compete; confirm no restraint on our business embedded there or in 14.11 No Resale before concluding absent.
No exclusive-supply clause apparent; verify 14.16 and the Services scope (13.1) do not require us to source hosting solely from IBM.
No MFN heading; scan Charges (4.1) for any obligation that we extend IBM our best terms, and note absence of an MFN in our favour.
14.8 Personnel is the likely home for any hiring/solicitation restriction; if present, seek mutuality, a 12-month limit and a general-advertising carve-out.
3.4 governs convenience termination — check notice length, whether IBM has a symmetric right, and any termination charges cross-referenced in 3.5 or 4.1.
3.2 Renewal: confirm auto-renewal length, non-renewal notice window (target 30 days) and any uncapped price uplift, reading with Term (3.1) and Charges (4.1).
14.3 Choice of Law is primary; check for venue/forum language and whether 14.4 jury waiver and 14.19 geographic scope affect our position.
14.10 Assignment: seek our right to assign to affiliates/successors without consent and remove any IBM termination right on our change of control (also check 3.3 triggers).

Ownership of our content/data likely addressed across the licence (12.1), Limitation of Licenses (14.17), Content and Digital Certificates (11.6) and Data Protection (14.18); confirm no grant of our IP or data to IBM and that data return is preserved at 3.5.
12.1 License is the grant — test for affiliate/contractor use rights, non-revocability at will, and any narrowing in 14.17 or 14.11.
Suspected Violations (11.3) and the AUP (13.2) are the likely inspection/monitoring hooks; require notice, frequency limits and IBM-borne cost.
Check Payment (4.2) for interest/late charges and 3.5/9.2 for any penalty or early-termination amount payable by us; also note whether any service credits run in our favour.
5.1 is the IBM warranty; 5.2/5.4 disclaim everything else. Confirm a meaningful performance standard and remedy, supported by Services Support (11.1) and maintenance (12.2).
No insurance section in the outline; propose a standard insurance covenant given IBM hosts our data (see 5.3 Security, 14.12 Risk of Loss).
Charges (4.1) with Capacity Planning (11.5) and Term (3.1) are where any minimum/committed volume or take-or-pay would sit; if present, tie it to our convenience-termination exit.
3.5 Effect of Termination is the anchor — check for data return in a usable format, a defined retrieval window and transition assistance at agreed rates; 14.2 survival should cover it.
